hypotheses.P1_learned_bank_beats_random: Learned-prototype oracle direct-energy capture is at least twice the matched random-bank oracle on every corpus.
hypotheses.P2_state_router_retains_direct_energy: State-routed prototypes capture at least 30% of optimal local rank-four direct energy on every corpus.
hypotheses.P3_finite_mlp_subspace_transfers: At 1% input edits, routed-prototype MLP-write effects have median subspace overlap at least 0.70 with local-optimal effects on every corpus.
hypotheses.P4_suffix_effect_partially_transfers: The corresponding final-logit effect subspaces have median overlap at least 0.40 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P5_finite_direct_energy_calibrates: Median finite MLP energy ratio differs from tangent routed capture by at most 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P6_direct_prototype_causality_is_ood_sta: Finite MLP subspace overlap drops by at most 0.15 from FineWeb to either OOD corpus.
